structured.answer: The account mostly pays 0% interest. The basic plan costs up to 10 ₪ a month, so I'll check with the bank that I'm on it. I should keep only what I need in the account, since 10,000 ₪ left there for ten years is worth about 8,203 ₪ in today's money. The page also mentions 15,000 ₪ as the point where the bank must send a letter. I'm not changing anything before I ask my son.

Two dates and a new order cancelling the plans. I couldn't tell what I will pay now and what I will pay later.
The interest section seemed to start in the middle ('ולכן כסף שעשוי לצאת היום...'). I missed its beginning.
This frightened me about my deposits, and nothing explained what to do about it.
